module.name: chart
module.title: Charts
module.description: Bar, line, area, donut and sparkline figures. Each renders a caption, summary and semantic data table always; the Chart.js visual is added on top only when the engine loads.

ui.name: area-chart
ui.summary: Renders area data as a figure: caption, summary, semantic table, and a hidden visual mount.
ui.guidance: The order is the design. The table is the chart - it is rendered first, always present, and never hidden by default. The canvas is an enhancement that becomes visible only after the engine initialises successfully, and the adapter reads its data *out of that table* rather than from a duplicate payload, so the picture and the numbers cannot drift apart. If the engine never loads, the page is a table: complete, readable, and printable. BarChartOpts, LineChartOpts, AreaChartOpts, DonutChartOpts and SparklineOpts are separate types rather than one type with a shape field, so a caller cannot ask for a donut with two axes and the gallery cannot render a shape nobody declared.

ui.name: chart-legend
ui.summary: Names each series in text with its colour swatch.
ui.guidance: The swatch is decoration: colour alone cannot distinguish series for a colour-blind reader, so the label is what carries the identity.
